### The Sixth Trumpet
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-sixth-trumpet
Passage: Revelation 9:20-21
Points:
- The devastating strike of the sixth trumpet represents a limited divine judgment rather than the final end-time judgment.
- The vast army of two hundred million illustrates an overwhelming, terrifying force whose destructive reach remains restrained by God.
- Survivors of these deadly plagues stubbornly refuse to abandon their demonic idolatry and moral wickedness.
- Divine afflictions serve as gracious warnings intended to awaken people to repentance, yet the irrationality of sin hardens their hearts.
- Believers must not be surprised by worldly impenitence, but should continually turn from sin in both good times and bad.
